paite: Ehud sih nung in Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh.
heading: Debora Leh Barak

paite: Huchi in Hazor a vaihawmpa, huai Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin kiang ah TOUPA'N akhawngta hi. Huai mi sepaih heutupen bel Sisera ahi a, Zentelte gam Haroseth ah ateng hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA asam uh. Huai mi in kangtalai zakua tak anei a, kum sawmnih sung Israel suante nakpitak in anuaisiah hi.
Huai lai in Lapidoth zi, zawlnei Deborah in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Ephraim tanggam a Ramah leh Bethel kho kikal a tum sing nuai ah Deborah ateng hi. Israel suante akiang ah avai uh hawmsak ding in ahong hoh zel uhi.
Kedesh Naphtali gam a pan Abinoam tapa Barak athukhak a, akiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, Tabor Tang kiang ah hohtou inla, Naphtali suante leh Zebulun suante mi singkhat pi in.
Huchi in Kishon lui ah Jabin sepaih heutu Sisera, akangtalaite leh amipite toh ka hon sawl ding; amah nang ka hon pe ding, chi in thu ahon pia ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Barak in akiang ah, "Hon tonpih lechin ka hoh ding. N'on tonpih kei dingleh ka hoh kei ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "K'on tonpih tham ding. Himahleh na hohna a minhoih loh lou ding na hi. TOUPA'N Sisera numei kiang ah akhawng ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in Deborah athou a, Barak toh Kedesh ah ahohta uhi.
Barak in Zebulunte leh Naphtalite Kedesh ah athukhakkhawm a; mi singkhat amah toh ahohtou ua; Deborah leng akiang uah ahohtou sam hi.
Ken mi Heber bel Mosi puzon Hobab suante lak a pan ana om tuam a, Kadesh kiang a Zaanaim gam a tosaw sing mun ah apuanin ava kai hi.
Abinoam tapa Barak bel Tabor tang ah ahohtou chih Sisera ahilh uhi.
Huchi in Sisera in akangtalai tengteng, sik kangtalai zakua leh aheute Zentelte gam Haroseth a pan, Kishon lui ah akaikhawm hi.
Huchi in Deborah in Barak kiang ah, "Khai le, tuni TOUPA'N Sisera hon piak ni ahi. Na makaipa TOUPA ahi kei a hia?" achi hi. Huchi in Barak Tabor tang a pan apaisuk a, mi singkhat in azuisuk uhi.
TOUPA'N Sisera leh akangtalai tengteng leh asepaih tengteng namsau in Barak ma ah ahihbuai gawpta a; akangtalai a pan Sisera akumkhia a, akhe in ataimang hi.
Barak in bel kangtalaite leh sepaihte Zentel gam Haroseth pha in adelh hi. Huchi in Sisera sepaih tengteng namsau in athat vek a; khat lel leng ahinghawi kei uhi.
Sisera bel Ken mi Heber zi Jael puanin ah khe in atailut hi. Hozor Kumpipa Jabin leh Ken mi Heber inkuante kikal ah lemna a-om hi.
Jael bel Sisera dawn ding in ahong pawt a, akiang ah, "Pu, hong lut in, ka kiang ah hong lut in; lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in puanin sung ah akiang ah alutta a, ama'n puan in akhuh hi.
Akiang ah, "Hehpih in tui tawmchik hon pe dih ve, ka dang atak mahmah hi," achi hi. Ama'n bawngnawi thawl ahong a, adawnsak a, akhuhkhum nawn hi.
Akiang ah, "Puanin kongpi ah ding inla, huchi in 'Hiai ah mi a-om hia?' chi a hon dot uleh, 'om lou' na chi zel in," achi hi.

Heber zi Jael in puanin khetkilhna ala a, sek atawi a, awlchik in akhe asuanphei a, khetkilhna in ahaizek ah akhen paisuak a, lei toh akilhbelh hi. Bah in a-ihmut alim mahmah ngal a; huchi in asita hi.

Ngai in, Barak in Sisera ahon delh a, amah tuak ding in Jael ava pawt a, akiang ah, "Hong pai in, na mi zon ka hon ensak ding," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah ava hoh a; ngai in, Sisera ana sita mai a, ahaizek ah puanin khetkilhna ana tal hi.
Huchi in Pathian in huai ni in Israel suante ma ah Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah hi.
Kanaan kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah masiah uh, Kanaan kumpipa Jabin tung ah Israel suante ahat semsem uhi.
